thread:
maya: Quick q — if we need to revoke the realtime-v3 rollout, who can flip the feature flag `realtime-v3-enabled` in prod? need to do this immediately for a customer-facing incident and we need the audit path to paste into the incident doc.

sergio: Platform/SRE groups have LaunchDarkly access. Eng-oncall can also call the internal rollback API but only if you have the emergency role. If you don't, ping SRE oncall.

anya: Procedure we've been using recently:
1) Ping #eng-oncall + @sre-oncall with incident id.
2) Platform toggles the flag to `off` for prod targets (set 100% off for the release tag).
3) Add a LD comment with INC id.
4) POST an audit entry to /internal/audit/flags (inc id + reason).
5) Observe metrics for 5m and snapshot.

sam-plat: Quick LD steps for clarity: go to LaunchDarkly -> project Redwood -> feature `realtime-v3-enabled` -> prod environment -> Targeting -> remove all targeted rules or set default to OFF. Click "Save and comment" and include `INC-<id>`. LD records user+timestamp automatically.

athena-sec: Audit notes: LD stores the actor and comment. For the internal rollback API we require X-Triggered-By header and we write an audit record to the flags-audit service. If an ephemeral token was used, rotate it after the action. Also include the correlation id in logs.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Production toggles are gated. Only users in group `sre-platform` can call `/flag-toggle` in prod. All calls are logged to `/logs/flags-YYYYMMDD.log`.

maya: Will toggling cause any autoscaler churn or big backlog spikes?

sergio: Generally autoscaler is fine. But for the model hot path, flipping off could cause more CPU on fallback paths and batch sizes may change. If you're disabling a hot path, set the rollout config flag `freeze-scale=true` while you observe so pools don't aggressively downscale then up.

anya: I'll draft the SOC message once it's toggled: "Flag realtime-v3 disabled at 21:07 UTC by sergio (oncall) for high-latency incident. Audit: LD comment + internal audit id = <audit-id>."

sam-plat: Also double-check that you disable the canary audience tag (prod:canary-2026-03) in LD rules, otherwise some evaluations slip through. Use the release tag `prod-release:2026-03-17` when removing targets.

maya: Thanks. @sergio can you perform the toggle and drop the audit id here so I can paste into the incident note?

sergio: On it. Doing the LD toggle now. Comment: "disable realtime-v3 - INC-7889 - requested by maya"

oncall-bot: Toggle completed by sergio at 2112345695. Audit id: flag-audit-2112345695. LD comment saved.

maya: Got it — closing the loop and adding to the incident doc. Thanks everyone.
